title: The Powerful Secrets Granted to Human Beings
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum. They are from maashayikh al-kiram (Shaykh Adnan and Shaykh Hisham). I am
ashamed to speak in their presence. Laa ilaha illa-Llah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu
Akbar, laa ilaha illa-Llah. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi ‘l-hamd! Subhaan Sen, yaa Rabb! Sultan Sen,
yaa Rabb! Ahkaamu ‘l-Hakimeen Sensin, yaa Rabb! Allah, Allah. Zidh habeebika `izzan wa sharafan nooran
wa surooran, sultaanan wa ridwaana. Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alayka wa alaa `alika yaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen
wa ’l-akhireen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Shaykh Adnan Effendi, Hisham Effendi.... I may kiss their hands! It is easy to kiss their hands. Yaa Rabbee!
O People! O Children of Adam! We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'rRahmani 'r-Raheem.
O Mankind! There are billions of (human beings among) Mankind and I am only one weak servant amongst
billions of people. Sometimes people fear a virus; why must billions of people be afraid? I am not like a virus.
If you take billions and billions of viruses, all of them can't be one man's size, but one of them is making
people fear. You or others may say, "That person is only one and we will not pay attention to him!" They are
such foolish ones.

You fear a virus and kill thousands of chickens and cows from your fear! (Allah Almighty is saying,) “You fear
a virus and not Me!” Who is putting that secret power in that virus, making people fear it? If He is going to
put (power) in one servant, that one may make the east of the world (migrate) to the west, yes!
All power is for the Creator! You are not creators, you are creatures. Creatures are also in Creation and they
have a special position, yes. One of them may make east (move) to west, or to put west to east, or make some
continents under the oceans, or bring something from under oceans up. SubhaanAllahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l`Azheem! We are giving our oath that we are accepting our Creator as Lord of Heavens, Allah (swt)!
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Now we are forgetting that just we gave our oath that we are His servants.
O People! Throughout the east and west, are you thinking even once about for which thing you are in
existence? Is anyone asking? No one is asking, "Why am I here? How did I come here and for what have I
been created? Who brought me to this life? What is the purpose? For what am I created and for what is all
Mankind created and given a power in their minds to know something?" Why are we not using that secret
power?
O Mankind! Everyone has that secret power and it is a grant from the Lord of Heavens, as-sirr, secret power!
We have been granted this, and each one's secret power is different. Just as our out-looking (outer
appearance) is different, so too are our inner lives, our inner positions different. You can’t find two to be the
same, no! Are we using that? Mankind must think about it sometimes.
“Am I really a living one? Yes, I am a living one, but tomorrow I may be a non-living one.” That is a common
question people may ask themselves. “Today I am here, tomorrow I don't know if I am going to be here, over
the world or under it." People are not using this secret power. They are running after atomic reactors,
devoting their minds to it. You are searching, searching, searching and bringing this cursed technology.
Technology is cursed! If it was not cursed, it would only come from Heavens with the Lord's blessings!
However, people are trying, trying, trying to advance technology, and atomic reactors are taking all their
attention.

SubhaanAllah, all glory is for the Lord of Heavens! Up to 2011, they were thinking everything is okay and
“under our control." Since one month or forty days, everything changed! Up to 2011, people thought, "We

may control everything on Earth through our technology." Technology was under their control but now
people are saying, "No, (about your technology) we are not listening to you!" No one is asking for technology.
(Tyrants are saying,) "Why are you not obeying us? We were expecting your obedience to our laws.”
(The people are saying,) “We were also waiting, and expecting that one day you would be obedient to our
Lord, Who made you an authority to use us! But until now you have not changed your ways and you are
saying, ‘We have reached the top point of technology and no power can face us!’ Therefore, up to today we
were obedient to your orders, but now, up to the end we are not going to be held under your willpower! Your
mentality is to not obey anyone, and we were under your control and obedient, but nothing lasts forever. We
may go up to a certain point, but after some time cannot go beyond, that can't be. Therefore, now we have
been ordered not to be under your commands, finished!”
That is making all countries, particularly the most developed ones like Japan, Germany, France, England, US
…. Now people lost their mentalities, just reached down, down, down to a zero point. All nations are saying,
"There is no longer a way for us to move." Wa li-kulli qawmin haad, “For people there is a limit.”
Now the heavenly order for every power station on Earth is not to obey disobedient servants (tyrants,
dictators)! If they are insisting (on the citizens’ obedience to their tyranny) they are going to order those
reactors to attack you. And when the attack is coming, not thousands or millions, but billions will pass away!
That is well known through some secret “power people”; they know it. In one second that may poison this
atmosphere and those who are protected will be in safety, but those for whom it is written to be taken away
by heavenly revenge must (be finished).
O People! I am a weak servant and I have been ordered to make people wake up and remember what was
their oath on the Day of Promises; they forgot it and they must be reminded! There will also come a very
heavy, huge explosion that will lay dead those who hear it!
O Mankind! Beware and say, "O our Lord! Forgive us. O our Lord! We are asking for Your blessings." We
must say this as it is mentioned in all holy books, and now the Last Days before the Day of Judgement are
approaching so quickly! May Allah forgive us.

O People! Keep your adab, the high respect, for heavenly rules. Don't insist for anything beyond heavenly
rules. Leave democracy, otherwise you will all pass away!
O People! Don't kill each other; it is forbidden. Don't say, "I am here, I don't like anyone else (to tell me what
to do)." No, that was the way of Pharaoh, who said, ‘ana rabbukum al-`alaa, "I am your lord most high!" Now
all people are saying, "I am god and others must obey me." Why? Why is the Libyan tyrant president or the
Egyptian or Syrian tyrants saying this? What is the difference between common people and them? They come
from the common people! If you (tyrants) are sitting on a chair with an imitated title, do you think you
become something else? If so, don’t use the WC (toilet)! You are just like us, eating, drinking and going to the
WC; that is your work! All people must be true slaves to Allah Almighty! May Allah forgive us.
O People! May Allah forgive me and forgive you in this holy month that is coming now. May Allah bless and
forgive us, for the honor of the Seal of Prophets (s)! Allahuma salli `alaa Sayyidina Muhammad! (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.
(Baya`)
